name: Capital Slipway
subject: CAPITAL SLIPWAY TIER I. A large specialist orbital dock for assembling a single super-capital ship: ONE very long open construction cradle supported by two heavy segmented exterior trusses, THREE separated monumental gantry frames with inward-facing clamps, one compact service/control pod attached at the back end and paired heat radiators. Strong long-axis industrial silhouette, larger spans and heavier beams than a normal orbital shipyard, with no ship inside. There is no solid ground-like floor under the open cradle.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single standalone orbital construction-station sprite for a space strategy game's planetary view, with genuine transparent alpha. Landscape canvas.
Input image 1 is a MATERIAL/RENDERING reference only, the approved surface Shipyard. Do NOT copy its building, roof, feet, floor or ground layout. Input image 2 is the LIGHTING reference only, the Boreal planet painting; do NOT include any planet, sky, stars, horizon or terrain.
Create one FREE-FLOATING SPACE STRUCTURE with a long, low, wide silhouette approximately 3 times wider than tall. Empty vacuum visible through the open construction berth. Near-future frontier engineering, matte slate graphite steel and pale grey panels, restrained amber work lights and a few cyan docking lights, large readable forms, realistic restrained detail, soft semi-realistic environmental 3D rendering, no ink outlines or cel shading.
Camera: elevated three-quarter front-left, about 30 degrees above the station's longitudinal plane, mild perspective, long axis runs almost horizontally left to right with a slight diagonal. Consistent gentle upper-left sunlight and neutral/cool fill matching the reference.
Framing: complete structure centered with at least 8% transparent margin, all docking arms and radiators visible. True zero-alpha transparency outside and through the open framework. No ambient ground shadow or drop shadow; self-shadow within the machinery is fine.
No text, logos, numerals, UI, borders, people, spaceships, completed ship, engine exhaust, ground, roads, landing platform, landing legs, grass, rock, planet or background. Do not generate a lineup or multiple separate stations.
